description: The two ways statement-position markup renders compile clean: the single element of an `if` / `else` branch (the §17.6.10 implied `lift`, including a single-element `${ if }` nested inside such an element) and an explicit `lift` (several per arm, after a statement, in a `for` body).
rationale: §17.6.10.1: statement-position markup renders "as the single element of an `if` / `given` branch (the implied `lift` above), or named by a `lift` (§10.1)"; only markup neither way reaches is E-MARKUP-STATEMENT-NOT-RENDERED.
